以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
On Sunday, August 16, Hanshin played Hiroshima at Mazda Stadium. The game was not easy from the start. It began with one big swing, stayed close in the middle, and opened up late.

In the first inning, Teruaki Sato hit a two-run home run to center field. Hanshin took a 2–0 lead, but the game was far from over.

In the fifth inning, Elehuris Montero hit a solo home run for Hiroshima. It was Hiroshima’s only run. The score was 2–1, and Hiroshima was within one run.

Hanshin’s starting pitcher, Rihito Ihara, pitched five innings. He allowed two hits and one run, keeping Hiroshima from building a bigger attack.

Hanshin added more runs in the seventh and eighth innings. Sakamoto and pinch-hitter Fushimi drove in runs in the seventh, and Sakamoto added another with a timely double in the eighth.

The early lead became a big advantage. Hanshin finished with an 8–1 victory. It was not just one big moment. The team took control, protected its lead, and added more when it mattered.

【Point One】
The final score looks comfortable, but the game was tight for a while. After Sato’s two-run homer, Montero’s solo shot made it 2–1. The key change came later, when Sakamoto and Fushimi added runs in the seventh, followed by another Sakamoto hit in the eighth. Hanshin secured the win with late extra runs.

【Point Two】
Ihara’s start shows another side of the win. He did not need a shutout. He gave up two hits and one run in five innings, and Hiroshima’s only run came on Montero’s solo homer. One home run is different from a long attack. Ihara limited the damage, and Hiroshima could not turn it into a bigger inning.
